title: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 arrives in Europe
description: Following its announcement in China back in September, Xiaomi has now brought its Smart Band 11 to Europe. The fitness tracker is available directly from Xiaomi’s online stores across the region and it comes in two versions. There’s a standard model priced at €60 and an NFC-equipped version going for €80. From a quick browse on Xiaomi Spain, we can see the Band 11 comes in midnight black, glacial silver and mystic rose colors. Xiaomi is also advertising a ceramic white edition of the Band 11 but there are no pricing and availability details for now. As a recap, Smart Band 11 brings...

title: Apple responds to the iPhone Duo inner display cracking issue
description: Apple has responded to the reports regarding the iPhone Duo inner display cracking. In a statement to 9to5Mac, the company acknowledged that it is aware of the issue and has offered a basic suggestion. The company sent the following statement as a response (emphasis ours): "The response to iPhone Duo from early users has been incredibly positive, and we are seeing exciting things from developers who are rapidly updating their apps to take advantage of its unique form factor. We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units. If users...

title: iOS 27.2 update rolling out with these new features
description: Apple is seeding the iOS 27.2 update for supported iPhone models with several new features and fixes for over 160 security vulnerabilities. The iOS update brings new languages to Siri AI, Apple Pencil (USB-C) support on the iPhone Duo, and a lot more. Siri AI is now available in French, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, and Portuguese on the iPhone 15 Pro series and iPhone 16 models. The iOS 27.2 update also introduces Suggestions in Messages, Shared Albums in Photos, and support for SynthID watermarks in Photos and Image Playground. In the Apple TV app, users get a new Simple Profiles...

title: India's smartphone market just had its worst quarter in a decade, Counterpoint says
description: Last week, Omdia reported that India's smartphone shipments dropped 26% in Q3 to their lowest level since 2016. Now Counterpoint Research has published its own numbers, and while they're a bit less dire, they paint the same picture. Shipments apparently fell 20% year-on-year in July-September, to their lowest level in a decade. Unsurprisingly, record-high memory prices are to blame, since they drove up device costs. With demand staying soft, brands also kept less stock in stores, even ahead of the festive season. The cheaper end of the market took the hardest hit. Shipments of phones under...

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max get listed by European retailer before their global launch
description: Xiaomi unveiled the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max in China back in September, and a day later it confirmed that both are going global. Today, Italian retailer Epto has listed the two phones ahead of their international debut, revealing their European prices, colors, and specs. The Xiaomi 18 Pro is listed at €1,398.90 with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage, and €1,591.90 with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. The 18 Pro Max only comes with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, for €1,783.90. Some Pro Max listings in white and Velvet Red, with different model numbers, are slightly cheaper...

title: Samsung's Exynos 2700 reportedly outpaces the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max's Snapdragon by up to 20%
description: Back in August, insiders claimed that the Exynos 2700 beat Qualcomm's next flagship chips in internal testing. Those Snapdragons have since become official, and Samsung has reportedly put its upcoming chip up against them once again. The Exynos 2700 is expected to power at least some models in the Galaxy S27 series, which should arrive early next year. This time, the tests were allegedly run against the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and its Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. The Exynos 2700 reportedly scored around 13,000 points in the Geekbench 6.5 multi-core CPU test, compared to around 11,000 for...

title: T-Mobile's new T-Mix plans let you pick your own perks
description: T-Mobile has recently been rumored to be preparing new T-Mix branded plans, and today they're finally official. There are three tiers, called Standard, More, and Loaded, and they'll be available in November. The big idea is that instead of coming with a fixed set of benefits, each plan gets a number of "Picks", which you can spend on the perks you actually want. T-Mix Standard starts at $55/month for one line with one Pick, T-Mix More is $75/month with two Picks, and T-Mix Loaded is $95/month with three Picks. All of those prices are with AutoPay, plus taxes and fees. On Loaded, the...

title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo key specifications leak
description: Motorola accidentally teased the yet to launch Edge 70 Neo back in August, which was followed by leaked renders later that month. The renders showcased the phone’s design and color options, but a new leak has now revealed its key specifications. According to the leak, the Motorola Edge 70 Neo will feature a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate. The handset is tipped to be powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset. For optics, the device is said to sport a 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 primary rear camera alongside a 2MP macro sensor. It could also feature a rear-mounted light...

title: Apple teases more launches this week after the new iPad mini
description: Apple has scheduled an event for this Wednesday, October 28, but it's not waiting until then to announce new products. Today, it unveiled the new iPad mini, and according to Greg Joswiak, Apple's SVP of Worldwide Marketing, that's only the beginning. In a post on X, Joswiak said "It's going to be an exciting week", one that starts with the iPad mini, and called the tablet "the biggest update ever to iPad mini". In case you missed it, the new model has an 8.5-inch 1512x2316 OLED screen, the A20 Pro chipset, and an IP67 rating for dust and water resistance, all in a 5.4mm thin body. It’s...

title: Samsung is reportedly making 20% fewer Galaxy A phones this quarter
description: Memory prices have been skyrocketing for a while now, and that has been eating into smartphone makers' margins. Samsung's mobile division in particular is reportedly facing its first-ever annual loss. Today, a new report out of Korea claims the company is responding by cutting Galaxy A production in the fourth quarter of the year (October to December) by about 20% compared to its original plans. Samsung has allegedly already passed the reduced volumes on to its supply chain. One industry source reportedly claims component orders for Q4 are down about 20% from the production plan Samsung...

title: The OLED iPad mini is here with A20 Pro chip and acoustic display speakers
description: Apple unveiled its updated iPad mini model, which brings the first OLED display to the mini line. Alongside the expected display upgrade, Apple outfitted the new mini model with its latest Apple A20 Pro chip, though there is a catch. The 128GB and 256GB storage versions get a binned CPU featuring five CPU cores compared to six on the 512GB model. Per the specs page, the lower storage models are getting one less efficiency core and half the NPU power. The rest of the specs are identical. iPad mini (2026) brings binned A20 Pro chips for the 128GB and 256GB configs The new mini is...

title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra's full camera setup leaks
description: Oppo's Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max went global recently, but the brand's top camera flagship for this generation is still a few months away. Today, Digital Chat Station posted what's allegedly the full camera setup of the Find X10 Ultra. The phone reportedly has a 200MP main camera with a 1/1.12-inch type sensor and LOFIC technology, a 200MP periscope telephoto with a 1/1.3-inch type sensor, and a 50MP periscope telephoto with 10x optical zoom. The front allegedly gets a 100MP selfie camera with a 1:1 square sensor. The tipster lists the main sensor's model as HPA/HPU, which makes us...

title: iPhone Duo bend test doesn't end well
description: Earlier today, we wrote about iFixit's teardown of the iPhone Duo, which addressed some of the concerns about the phone's inner folding screen and its hinge design - we've already seen plenty of reports about the inner screen getting damaged, even though the iPhone Duo only became available (in limited quantities, no less) a few days ago. [#InlinePriceWidget,13804,1#] Now we can shift our attention towards another important question: will the iPhone Duo bend? And for that we can only look towards Zack from the YouTube channel JerryRigEverything, who's been trying to bend phones left and...

title: OnePlus Ace 7 Pro camera specs and samples revealed ahead of launch
description: Ahead of its launch later this week, OnePlus has been slowly teasing the Ace 7 lineup’s features. Today, the company has revealed the Ace 7 Pro’s rear camera details and also shared several camera samples. The OnePlus Ace 7 Pro will feature a 200MP main rear camera alongside a periscope telephoto unit with 3.5x optical zoom support. OnePlus also shared a bunch of wide and zoom camera samples taken on the Ace 7 Pro on Weibo. Apart from confirming key camera specs of the Ace 7 Pro, OnePlus also revealed that both the Ace 7 and the Pro will feature a BOE display with...

title: OnePlus Buds Clip go official with dual drivers and up to 40 hours of battery life
description: Without much fanfare, OnePlus announced its first clip-on earbuds – the aptly named OnePlus Clip. And while the brand's smartphones are no longer available in Europe and the US, the Buds Clip will be available in some global regions, as evidenced by their listing on the global OnePlus website. They bring Dynaudio sound tuning, dual drivers and up to 40 hours of battery life. Buds Clip employ 11mm woofers and 9mm tweeters alongside dual DACs tuned by Danish audio brand Dynaudio. You get support for LHDC 5.0, AAC and SBC codecs. The buds pair over Bluetooth 6.1 and support simultaneous...

title: Poco X8s debuts with a 6.35-inch OLED display, Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset
description: The Poco X8 series gets a new model in global markets. Poco has unveiled the new X8s with a compact design and a triple-rear camera setup. It features a 6.35-inch LTPO AMOLED display that offers a resolution of 1.5K and a refresh rate of 120Hz. The panel also offers up to 3,500 nits of peak brightness and features 1.18mm slim and uniform bezels. The Poco X8s is powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, paired with up to 12GB of RAM and 512GB of internal storage. For photography, the phone has a 50MP Light Fusion 800 main rear sensor, a 50MP telephoto camera, and an 8MP ultrawide...

title: iPhone Duo teardown reveals it is fairly repairable but its complex hinge is worrying
description: The iPhone Duo is the hottest thing in tech right now and iFixit have published their signature teardown. It addresses the recent reports of malfunctioning hinges on some early units while also giving us an in-depth look at the internals of the first folding iPhone. Let's start with the positive – the Duo earned a 5/10 repairability rating, which puts it in a class of its own when it comes to foldables. For reference, Samsung’s Z Fold8 got a 4/10 score while its predecessor earned a 3/10 rating. As per the folks over at iFixit, most of the components inside the Duo are fairly...

title: vivo Y600 is official with a 10,000mAh battery and 6.83-inch display
description: The vivo Y600 is now available for pre-order in China, as promised, with open sales set to begin on October 30. The phone packs a massive 10,000mAh battery and has also earned a Guinness World Record for battery endurance. As per the Guinness World Records test, the phone lasted for 32 hours and 37 minutes during a continuous livestream test. The 10,000mAh battery supports 44W wired fast charging and reverse wired charging. The handset sports a 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and is powered by the Dimensity 7300e chipset. It also gets a 50MP primary rear sensor...

title: OnePlus 15 starts receiving the stable ColorOS 17 update based on Android 17
description: Back in July, OnePlus confirmed that all eligible OnePlus devices will switch from OxygenOS to ColorOS with the Android 17 update, in all regions. Now, that switch is starting to happen for the OnePlus 15, which is getting the stable ColorOS 17 update starting today, carrying the build number CPH2745_17.0.0.102(EX01). The caveat is that the rollout is only happening in India for the time being. [#InlinePriceWidget,14206,1#] The headline change is a new fluid design with responsive light effects and animations, powered by a new Luminous Rendering Engine, along with a redesigned Lock...

title: Early iPhone Duo buyers report inner display damage caused by a potential hinge defect
description: Buyers of Apple's first foldable, the iPhone Duo, are reporting a serious issue online with their purchase. All reports demonstrate a common pattern of a vertical and a horizontal line appearing on the inner display as a result of a potential hinge malfunction. Image source: scary_duck23 (Reddit) According to these reports, at some point after the purchase of the phone, the hinge felt unusually stiff and opening the phone required some effort. When the user pushed past the resistance, a popping or cracking sound was heard from the hinge, and a permanent vertical and horizontal line...
